figures.claim: The knee flexes more during stance than in walking, often to around 40 degrees, because there is more to absorb.
Swing flexion is also much greater, often beyond 100 degrees, to bring the heel through quickly.
Stance falls from about 60 per cent of the cycle to nearer 30.
